art_direction: Friendly premium management-game illustration, orthographic 2:1 isometric projection, readable silhouettes at gameplay zoom, warm upper-left light, cream painted surfaces, cedar-brown roofs and trim, deep parkland green accents, restrained dark outlines, transparent background, no text or logos, no baked cast shadow.

image_batches.brief: Generate the Parkland clubhouse hero and matching pro shop, snack bar, restroom, bench, and wide six-bay driving range as separate transparent drop-in game assets using the shared art direction and existing canvas/anchor contracts.
image_batches.notes: Driving range used one reroll to obtain the required wide silhouette.

image_batches.brief: Generate a cohesive Parkland environment set: tall mature oak, narrow pine, small gray rock, low flower bed, pin flag, and compact golf cart, each isolated on transparency with bottom-center ground contact.
image_batches.notes: Oak used one reroll to improve its tall gameplay silhouette.

image_batches.brief: Create two full-body golfer tier references in the Parkland style: a beginner in white cap, coral polo, tan shorts, and a pro in white visor, navy polo, stone trousers; preserve a clear golf club and stable feet for animation reference.

Create a seven-material Parkland terrain reference board showing grass, striped fairway, rough, putting green, bunker sand, water, and path with consistent isometric lighting and immediately distinct gameplay reads.

motion_batch.brief: Animate each approved golfer reference as a short side-view walk and golf swing while preserving costume, proportions, stable ground contact, and the reference illustration style.
motion_batch.notes: Beginner walk is proof-only because the club position drifts between frames.

promotion_policy: Only visually reviewed, contract-safe static assets were promoted. Motion and terrain-board outputs remain references.
